sentences.text: She grows tomatoes, carrots, and lettuce.
Every day, she waters her plants.
Lily wants to eat healthy food.
She wants to help the Earth too.
One day, Lily sees a problem.
"I need to help my garden!" She thinks of a plan.
She will collect it in a big bucket.
The next day, she waters her garden with rainwater.
She tells her friends about her garden.
"You can do this too!" she says.
They want to help the Earth.
Lily and her friends have a big picnic.
